answer: An oasis water council could, for example, require a bond per voting key for the full 30-day decision horizon. Its escrow contract locks each deposited unit to one key until voting closes, blocking a vote-withdraw-reregister spiral. Extra identities require extra locked capital, even if borrowed; this prices Sybils rather than proving personhood. Example: a hypothetical 40-credit bond per identity means 25 identities lock 1,000 credits for 30 days: 30,000 credit-days of non-shareable capital.
